title: SAINT LAURENT - MEN'S SUMMER 26 SHOW
summary: Anthony Vaccarello's Summer 2026 menswear collection for Saint Laurent captures a moment between Paris and Fire Island, blending escape with elegance and desire with expression. The collection honors a lost generation of artists and Yves Saint Laurent, who found refuge in 1974 to create anew. It draws inspiration from a time when desire was synonymous with style and beauty shielded against emptiness, exploring a subtle sensuality where dressing reveals and conceals. Vaccarello opts for the clarity of afternoon light, avoiding artificial glow, and focuses on presence and exposure. The collection features an installation by Céleste Boursier-Mougenot, with porcelain bowls creating resonance. Silhouettes are sculpted with cinched waists and extended shoulders, using materials like silk and nylon in a muted palette of sand, salt, pale ochre, dry moss, and pool blue. The collection emphasizes continuity rather than homage or memory, with a sensuality devoid of theatrics. Shorts reminiscent of those worn by a young Yves Saint Laurent appear without direct reference, highlighting recurrence. The space and fabric breathe, maintaining a sense of continuity from 1974 to 2026. The soundtrack is by SebastiAn.

title: 🎬 Documentary: Real Venda Style of Living in Venda Village
summary: The documentary "Real Venda Style of Living in Venda Village" offers an authentic glimpse into the daily life of a traditional South African Xhosa community. Available on Zland DigiMarket, it showcases the communal lifestyle of young Venda women living in a rondavel, engaging in activities like cooking, braiding hair, and gathering vegetables by hand. The film captures the genuine rhythm of rural life, featuring traditional dances, chants, and lively conversations that highlight the spirit of Xhosa youth. The women wear traditional Vendas clothing, and the documentary emphasizes cultural integrity, portraying tradition with dignity rather than as entertainment. It serves as a visual anthropology tool, demonstrating intergenerational learning and survival skills, and is used in heritage programs and African studies. Filmed in March 2025 in a real Vendas village in the Eastern Cape, South Africa, the documentary features real villagers, guided by Xhosa community elders for accuracy. It includes cultural nudity, with viewer discretion advised for those under 18. The audio is entirely original, with songs and voices captured on location. The documentary is available for secure digital download or private streaming, with subtitles in English and French. Supporting this documentary helps preserve endangered African traditions, empower local storytellers, and fund future fieldwork by ZuluLand Official TV. Produced by ZuluLand Official TV, it is intended for academic use or licensing, with unauthorized copying prohibited.

title: 😳 Comment vivent vraiment les femmes en Iran ? Des faits surprenants sans censure

Les mariages temporaires et les risques liés à des tenues jugées inappropriées illustrent les contradictions culturelles. Le documentaire couvre l'histoire de l'Iran, de la Perse antique à la révolution islamique, et examine les enjeux modernes comme le pétrole, l'usage d'Internet et la double réalité vécue par les Iraniens. Il met en lumière la culture, l'art et l'architecture du pays, tout en offrant des conseils pour voyager en Iran. Avec une population majoritairement jeune, l'Iran est au cœur d'un mouvement de contestation. Le projet vidéo indépendant vise à informer et éduquer sur la culture et l'histoire iraniennes, sans promouvoir la violence ou la discrimination.

Le terme « génocidaire » est également utilisé de manière abusive pour désigner les partisans de Benyamin Netanyahou, bien que tous ne soutiennent pas les actions de l'armée israélienne. Le véritable débat autour de Gaza se situe entre communautaristes et universalistes pour les juifs, et entre occidentalistes et universalistes pour les non-juifs.
